scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run test:core-foundation && npm run test:core-turns && npm run test:other
scripts.test:core-foundation: vitest run tests/core.test.ts -t 'course generation|clubhouse economy|automatic course shuffle'
scripts.test:core-turns: vitest run tests/core.test.ts -t 'plays one visible|blocks, reflects|keeps round effects|supports targeted|applies specialist|freezes turns|accepts legal' && vitest run tests/core.test.ts -t 'feeds selected|uses temporary|adds aerial|keeps timers|preserves item|places one legal' && vitest run tests/core.test.ts -t 'scores each resolved'
scripts.test:other: vitest run tests/app-controller.test.ts tests/feedback.test.ts tests/hazards.test.ts tests/markup.test.ts tests/party-rules.test.ts tests/physics.test.ts tests/preferences.test.ts tests/render.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:server && npm run test
